question: Does this machine already hold one executable policy task on which working and changed deployments can differ only in bound normalizer statistics, with an observable task outcome, so that a prospective keep or replace decision can be adjudicated and confirmed?
execution_rule: No consequential policy-task output is inspected unless one held candidate satisfies all seven criteria and Opus has frozen endpoints, tolerances, assignments and stopping rules. A candidate failure produces an evidence-acquisition result, not a substitute toy task.

resource_boundaries.substantial_execution: requires a separate measured estimate and reservation after qualification

cost_accounting.inventory_process_cpu: measured prospectively by the inventory process
cost_accounting.preliminary_shell_reads: preserved separately with wall time and unknown process CPU
cost_accounting.nested_timings: reported but never added to enclosing command wall time

stopping_rule: Stop after the frozen held-asset screen if no candidate satisfies all seven criteria; name exact missing assets, lawful access, sizes, compute needs and cap conflicts for the best-scored candidate.
